topography.project_purpose: Canonical Bridge. Structurally: 115 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 24 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC1155 multi-token, 3 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 35 common project-authored base contract(s) (mintcontroller, controller, tellorstorage). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
